delegations: Inventory → Accounting: evaluate the 12-unit shortfall, modeled restock cost, and a sustainable discount.
Boss chooses a proposed manager price exception; Customer Service saves a counteroffer that states the stock limit. Boss closes the desk task without claiming a completed sale.
